slides.note: **protoAgent**: a self-hosted runtime for your own AI agents.
You use the console. Other agents talk **A2A**. Apps use **/v1**.
Models through a **gateway**, tools through **MCP**, features through **plugins**.
Inside: the **interfaces**, the **agent core**, and **platform services**.
The core is a **LangGraph** tool loop: subagents, middleware, checkpoints.
**Plugins**, scheduling, events and tracing, shared by every agent.
Follow one chat turn.
One runtime. **Your agents, your plugins, your model.**
Most of what protoAgent does ships as **plugins**: git repos you install, never a fork.
The plugin machinery lives in **platform services**, beside scheduling and events.
A plugin installs from a **git URL**, pinned in `plugins.lock`. Installing runs nothing: **enabling is the trust decision**.
The loader parses the **manifest** and runs the **deps and runtime gate**. Anything missing becomes a **setup-gap** banner with a fix button.
Follow one plugin from a git URL to the console rail.
`register(registry)` is the one seam. A plugin can add tools, views, skills, subagents, MCP servers, routes, surfaces, services and chat components.
Plugin code reaches core through **graph.sdk**: its own store, other plugins' services, files, knowledge, jobs and traces.
Watch a plugin tool use the SDK.
In the console, a plugin view is a sandboxed **iframe**. The **plugin-kit** speaks a postMessage bridge: theme, events, code links, chat drafts.
First-party plugins live in their own repos. **Atlas**, the plugin drawing this diagram, is one of them.

tours.title: The fleet at work, under the hood

slides.note: A protoAgent can run a **fleet**: a hub agent plus members, spawned on this box or **paired** from another machine.
Inside the hub, the **Fleet** subsystem spawns, pairs, proxies and delegates.
The **supervisor** starts each local member as its own process, with its own workspace, port and model.
A remote member is **paired** with a one-time code, which gets the hub a revocable token of its own.
Everything reaches a member through `/agents/<slug>/…`. The **proxy** swaps the loopback **fleet token** for the paired token at the hop.
**delegate_to** is the one tool. Every dispatch goes through the registry, and the **ledger** records each one.
Every member speaks **A2A**: an auth gate, a JSON-RPC handler, a durable task store, and an executor that streams the turn.
Follow one delegation from your question to the hub's answer.
